profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software engineer at Microsoft working primarily to solve problems with AI solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Working on Microsoft’s Turing team, specializing in post‑training of large language models (fine‑tuning, and evaluation) to power Copilot capabilities across Microsoft products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer at Microsoft on MAIDAP (Microsoft AI Development Acceleration Program)

•	Designed and implemented a C# API, enabling users to view accessible models, datasets, and associated runs at a per-sample level through Kusto queries. Enhanced user access to critical information and addressed a significant information gap. Developed Python infrastructure for automatically extracting model insights and developed an offline pipeline that reduced the necessary dataset samples by up to 140x smaller, while maintaining unbiased results. Offline pipeline was used to support runs in an AML pipeline. 
•	Led the incubation of a self-healing feedback loop for customer feedback, collaborating with Applied Scientists to design an evaluation pipeline. architected and integrated a copilot-feedback solution using a llm-based evaluation using C#, Python, and GPT-4 through Azure. Integrated with four main Microsoft services, ensuring secure authentication and gaining buy-in from relevant stakeholders. Currently pursuing a patent for this innovation.
•	Scaled and migrated a Knowledge Mining API from Docker container (on physical machine framework) to an internal Kubernetes solution (on Azure Virtual Machine framework), impacting millions of tenant-based copilot users worldwide by speeding up how quickly they are served tenant specific knowledge.

projects.title: Video Migration
projects.description:
Created a video migration Groovy on Grails internal application that is able to pull videos from a customer’s library and add them to Resi’s VOD service.
- Use of YouTube-dl to download a video, playlist, channel, or list of selected videos from YouTube, Livestream, Wistia, or Vimeo.
- Use of ffmpeg to transcode videos of multiple frames rates and aspect ratios.
- Required internal authentication and api calls to upload and archive videos.
Product is currently being deployed to beta to be used on customers, after a successful alpha.

projects.title: Blend Shaping
projects.description: This assignment was created by Dr. Shijiro Sueda, and was meant to teach the basics of Blend Shaping by creating multiple blend shapes by using Maya and going blending between the multiple shapes. These processes were first processed on the CPU then they were moved onto the GPU, by using vertex shader glsl files. All of the data that was found from https://facewaretech.com/.
